object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: With read-only mode off, leave typed text unsaved and run an action without moving the focus: text in VCU3-SRS-2's description cell editor, then New sibling; text in the Inspector's description and rationale fields, then Reload from disk; Inspector text, then Export; Inspector text, then a Table menu action; Inspector text, then Undo; Inspector text, then Compare of the latest commit with the working copy. Expected: each time the typed text is in the object file before the action takes effect: the exported PDF and the comparison show it, and Undo undoes it as the newest edit.
